Companions can chat by text, send photo, video, and voice messages, and take phone calls. The platform also offers AI image generation. It includes "Verified" AI versions of real models and OnlyFans creators, for which chatting costs extra tokens depending on the model's popularity. Free chatting with a created companion is mentioned, with premium features available.
